release_notes: Full UI redesign across all 52 screens. New teal and violet theme with a colour-blind-safe palette, duotone icons, consistent cards, headers, status chips and empty states. Home and Geo Tracking no longer render blank. Login no longer reports a healthy slow backend as a network error, and a slow connect is retried once. Attendance, leave, payments, HR, sales, vehicles and the full marketing module are restyled; no functional changes.
